relations.myth: Nanahuatzin ascends after becoming the Sun
relations.note: The upper primordial couple receives or positions the newly risen Sun.
Some scholarly mappings treat him as the male primordial parent.
relations.source: Leyenda de los Soles and related cosmologies

relations.note: León-Portilla identifies the old fire deity's parental title with Ometeotl.
León-Portilla treats Tezcatlipoca's overlapping epithets as manifestations of Ometeotl.
